title: Extinction Rebellion protest at Schiphol over aviation and climate
location: Multiple areas at Schiphol airport, including the departure hall, behind passport control and Schiphol Plaza.
participants_original: NOS reports several dozen at the permitted Schiphol Plaza demonstration; attendance at other locations and overall total are not stated.
threshold_50_evidence: The Plaza group is described as several dozen, which does not clearly reach 50; the report gives no total for the separate areas. Arrest count is not turnout.

start_date.summary: Both contemporary reports date the action to 6 February; NOS says it happened that morning.

location.summary: Reports describe activity at several airport locations, including departure hall, airside behind passport control, and Schiphol Plaza.

organizer.summary: Both reports identify Extinction Rebellion activists.

demands.summary: The opened accounts identify aviation’s role in the climate crisis and messages questioning KLM/Schiphol; they do not establish a specific demand directed to Dutch government policy.

participants_original.summary: NOS reports several dozen at Schiphol Plaza but provides no total across airport sites. NL Times reports no crowd estimate.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: Several dozen at Plaza is ambiguous against the 50 threshold; the number across separate sites is unknown.

state_response.arrests.summary: Seven activists were reported arrested in the departure hall. This is not an attendance count.

state_response.accommodation.summary: NOS says a permitted Plaza demonstration by several dozen was left undisturbed; whether this constitutes coded accommodation of a government demand is unresolved because no specific state-directed demand is established.

protester_violence.summary: The captured reporting does not establish protester violence; do not infer its absence.

notes: NOS says it worked with NH, so its NH-linked coverage is not independent confirmation. Keep the distinct airport areas, permit and arrests separate; arrest counts are not attendance. Government-directed demand and 50+ total remain unresolved.
open_questions: Find organizer or official statements establishing the action’s exact demand, total participants across airport locations, end time, and response to each group.

title: Demonstration against COVID-19 measures at Maastricht Vrijthof
threshold_50_evidence: An opened contemporary report describes about 200 people at the protest, well above 50; exact bounds were not stated.

start_date.summary: NL Times dates the gathering to Sunday 7 February and says people gathered from about 14:00.

location.summary: The reported gathering was at Vrijthof in Maastricht.

demands.summary: The report identifies an unannounced protest against COVID measures.

participants_original.summary: NL Times reports about 200; this is preserved as an approximate published estimate.

participants_estimate.summary: The published estimate is about 200; no exact bounds are reported.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: The report’s approximate estimate of about 200 clearly exceeds the project threshold.

end_date.summary: Police warnings preceded participants being moved from Vrijthof around 15:15 on 7 February. Departure from surrounding streets is not described.

state_response.crowd_dispersal.summary: The report says police warned participants and moved them off the square, with an emergency ordinance.

protester_violence.summary: The opened account does not establish violence by demonstrators; absence of such reporting is not coded as no_explicit.

notes: NL Times is the only current-unit opened account with usable event facts. Separate from Amsterdam’s “handful” on the same date; do not transfer arrests or other facts from failed local-source opens or from January events.
open_questions: Find direct local confirmation of attendance and determine whether the group dispersed completely or continued nearby.

title: COVID-measures demonstration lead at Amsterdam Museumplein, 14 February
participants_original: AT5 reports “dozens”; no exact number is given.
threshold_50_evidence: “Dozens” is qualitative and does not settle whether at least 50 people attended.

start_date.summary: AT5 explicitly reports the gathering on 14 February 2021.

location.summary: AT5 places the gathering at Museumplein in Amsterdam.

demands.summary: AT5 identifies a demonstration against coronavirus measures.

participants_original.summary: AT5 says “dozens”; it gives no exact count or bounds.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: The qualitative “dozens” report is too imprecise to determine whether the 50-person threshold was met.

protester_violence.summary: AT5 describes the atmosphere as calm at publication. This is limited to the observed period and does not establish no violence over the whole event.

notes: Do not import prior-weekend attendance, dispersals, arrests, or violence. The mayor’s security-risk designation was described as a response to earlier incidents, not a response to this gathering.
open_questions: Seek a contemporaneous count or another account clarifying whether the gathering reached 50; do not infer response or exact event end.

title: COVID-measures protest at Amsterdam Museumplein
threshold_50_evidence: NOS’s about-1,000 estimate for this specific gathering clearly exceeds 50; exact bounds were not stated.

start_date.summary: NOS reports the protest on Sunday 21 February and says participants gathered around 14:00.

location.summary: The gathering took place on Museumplein in Amsterdam.

demands.summary: NOS identifies opposition to COVID measures.

participants_original.summary: NOS reports about 1,000; this remains an approximate published estimate.

participants_estimate.summary: The reported estimate is about 1,000; it is not an exact count or bound.

state_response.crowd_dispersal.summary: After distancing calls around 15:30, police used vans and mounted officers to disperse the crowd and made a seated group leave.

state_response.arrests.summary: NOS reports one arrest in connection with the Amsterdam action; it does not specify more.

protester_violence.summary: The available opened account does not establish demonstrator violence; do not code silence as no_explicit.

notes: A physically distinct gathering from the Leeuwarden protest also reported by NOS that day. The reported police dispersal is tied to this Amsterdam protest.
open_questions: Clarify whether any participants remained nearby after dispersal and whether additional contemporary accounts describe the end.

title: Lockdown/curfew-opposition protest near the Fries Museum
participants_original: NOS describes several hundred people and identifies lockdown and curfew opponents within a mixed crowd.
threshold_50_evidence: NOS reports several hundred at this separate location; this establishes a crowd above 50, but the mix and exact number of policy protesters are not specified.

start_date.summary: NOS reports a distinct Leeuwarden gathering on 21 February around 14:00.

location.summary: The gathering was near the Fries Museum in Leeuwarden.

demands.summary: NOS identifies lockdown and curfew opponents among a mixed crowd; the common demand of the group is not fully specified.

participants_original.summary: NOS reports several hundred in the mixed gathering but does not quantify the policy-opposition subset.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: The report describes several hundred people, while not clarifying the size of the subset opposing restrictions.

protester_violence.summary: The opened report does not establish protester violence; silence does not establish its absence.

notes: Do not transfer the Amsterdam crowd, demand certainty, police response, or arrest to Leeuwarden. NOS says most had left around 16:00; this does not establish the final participant departure.
open_questions: Find an account establishing the crowd’s shared demand, how many participants opposed state restrictions, and whether the gathering ended or received a state response.

title: Extinction Rebellion Lenterebellie national kickoff climate actions
location: Coordinated actions reported in Amsterdam (Overtoom and later a Rijksmuseum intersection), Rotterdam (Erasmusbrug), and Utrecht; Tilburg was planned but not verified.
participants_original: NOS: about 80 at Amsterdam Overtoom; several dozen at Rotterdam Erasmusbrug. XR retrospectively estimates Rotterdam about 80. Utrecht arrest totals are not turnout; no nationwide total is reported.
threshold_50_evidence: NOS reports about 80 at Amsterdam Overtoom, one documented location in the coordinated 26 February kickoff; this alone exceeds 50. No national total is reported.

start_date.summary: NOS and XR date the executed kickoff actions to 26 February 2021; the XR press release S027 is only prospective.

location.summary: NOS reports actions in Amsterdam, Rotterdam and Utrecht; XR’s retrospective also names these cities. Tilburg appears in the prior plan only; its execution is unverified.

organizer.summary: The action is identified as XR’s nationally coordinated Lenterebellie kickoff; S027 describes the prospective plan and S028/S031 report actions.

demands.summary: XR and NOS describe a demand for government honesty about climate/ecological crises and an emergency declaration; political behavior/processes is used for the demand directed to national policy.

participants_original.summary: NOS estimates about 80 in Amsterdam and several dozen in Rotterdam; XR estimates about 80 in Rotterdam. Utrecht arrest totals (100 NOS; 110 XR, including people XR says did not blockade) are not attendance, and no total across cities is reported.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: The Amsterdam Overtoom site estimate of about 80 exceeds 50; it is not summed with other locations.

state_response.crowd_dispersal.summary: NOS describes police intervention in Amsterdam and Rotterdam, including forcing the Rotterdam group off the bridge.

state_response.arrests.summary: Arrests are reported in Rotterdam (NOS one; XR three, conflicting accounts) and Utrecht (NOS 100; XR 110, with XR noting some people did not blockade). These counts are not turnout.

state_response.beatings.summary: XR alleges officers pushed, kicked or struck participants in Rotterdam and Utrecht; this organizer allegation lacks independent confirmation in the captured reports and is left unknown pending review.

protester_violence.summary: The available reports do not establish violence by demonstrators. Arrests and police accounts do not establish protester violence.

end_date.summary: Local interventions are reported, but no complete physical end for the multi-site actions is established; Amsterdam participants appeared later at another intersection.

notes: Treat this as one nationally coordinated kickoff rather than adding city estimates or arrests into a fabricated national total. Individual assemblies may need separate coding; the Amsterdam estimate alone meets threshold, while Rotterdam and Utrecht remain locally ambiguous. S027 is a prospective plan; it does not prove an action in every listed city or on 27 February. Attribute the XR police-violence allegations; do not code them as independently established.
open_questions: Human review should decide whether this coordinated action is one multi-site national candidate or distinct local candidate rows; identify a reliable Utrecht crowd estimate, verify Tilburg participation, resolve Rotterdam attendance/arrest discrepancies and seek independent evidence on XR’s police-force allegations.

location.summary: Search-only titles identify Museumplein; no body was captured.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: Neither exact URL body was captured; no attendance threshold is verified.

notes: Both current exact-URL body attempts returned Cache miss. Headlines and search-only metadata do not establish event facts; no turnout, demand, police action or arrest count is coded.
